body.p: The FreeBSD installer programs allow the Ports Collection to be installed at the same time as the operating system. See bsdinstall for more information.
If the Ports Collection is not initially installed, it can be added with portsnap (if running FreeBSD 11.4 or 12.1) or Subversion (if running FreeBSD -CURRENT).
